papers.title: Leveraging Information Retrieval to Enhance Spoken Language Understanding Prompts in Few-Shot Learning
papers.authors: Pierre Lepagnol, Sahar Ghannay, Thomas Gerald, Christophe Servan and Sophie Rosset
bullets: Proposed a retrieval-augmented prompt construction method for few-shot spoken language understanding; improved intent classification and slot filling accuracy over random-shot baselines.

papers.title: Small Language Models are Good Too: An Empirical Study of Zero-Shot Classification
papers.authors: Pierre Lepagnol, Thomas Gerald, Sahar Ghannay, Christophe Servan and Sophie Rosset
bullets: Systematically benchmarked small LMs (< 1B params) against GPT-class models on zero-shot text classification; demonstrated competitive performance at a fraction of compute cost.
